# Armtrex Ltd

>  Armtrex LTD - Official Appointed Distributor/Seller for leading / advanced /cutting-edge manufacturer of defence and military artillery systems including advanced ammunition, weapons, energetic materials, and integrated security solutions.
## Company

- Legal name: Armtrex Ltd
- Company Reg. No.: 16573545
- Country of incorporation: United Kingdom
- Registered Office: Armtrex Ltd Office 3, 708 High Road, London, N12 9QL
- Certification: ISO 27001

## Pages

- [Home](/): Company overview, mission, vision, capabilities, and compliance posture.
- [Products](/products): KYC-gated product portfolio — artillery ammunition, mortar ammunition, unguided rockets, and propellant charges. Viewing requires a valid, time-limited access link issued after KYC and security clearance.
- [Contact](/contact): General enquiries.
- [KYC / Access Request](/kyc): Submit buyer/attendee KYC details to request product-catalogue access.

## Product categories

- Artillery Ammunition: 122mm, 152mm and 155mm HE / HE-FRAG / ER-BB / ER-BT / ERFB-BB / ERFB-BT projectiles.
- Mortar Ammunition: 60mm, 81mm, 82mm and 120mm HE-FRAG and thermobaric rounds.
- Unguided Rockets: 122mm M-21OF family.
- Propellant Charges: variable propelling charges, Bi-Modular Charge Systems (BMCS), and NATO-pattern bagged charges.

## Notes

- All product descriptions are drawn directly from manufacturer datasheets.
- defence-related and dual-use products are supplied only to governmental and authorized defence-sector customers under applicable UK and international regulations, export controls, end-user certification, and sanctions-compliance requirements.
- No commercial, technical, or contractual negotiation takes place prior to completion of KYC, security, and end-use capacity clearance.
